product_summary: Mruchem (mruchem.com), HQ Vadodara, Gujarat, founded by Mrugesh Parekh. Self-described 'emerging manufacturer and exporter of specialty chemicals'. Two product verticals on the site: (1) Surfactants / Surfactant Intermediates — Benzyl Chloride, SMCA, MCA, DMAPA, Dimethyl Sulphate, a full nonyl/octyl phenol ethoxylate range, fatty alcohol ethoxylates (ceto-stearyl, lauryl, stearyl, tridecyl), tallow amine/diamine ethoxylates, castor and hydrogenated castor oil ethoxylates, Tween/SPAN (Polysorbate 20/60/80), plus antimicrobials Chlorhexidine Gluconate and Phenoxy Ethanol, and a bare 'Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API)' heading with no named products; (2) Aroma Chemicals — page exists but contains zero product listings. Business model per the Contract Manufacturing page: Mruchem supplies raw material to ISO/GMP/FDA-certified toll manufacturers, takes the finished specialty chemical back, runs in-house QC and exports. The site also states it sources from 'major bulk chemical importers across India' and works with government chemical manufacturing organisations — i.e. a trading/contract-manufacturing layer on top of third-party plants, not a single-site producer.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — the site claims manufacturing but the disclosed model is toll/contract manufacturing at third-party FDA/GMP/ISO plants plus sourcing from bulk importers; no owned production site is named. Trader signs: 'one-stop solution to all your raw material needs', 'consolidated shipments', sourcing network from importers, and a product list spanning unrelated chemistries (chlorinated solvents intermediates + ethoxylates + antimicrobials + APIs + aroma) that no single plant would run.
comment: HS mapping vs declared 290399;291540;293399;340242. EXACT/PARTIAL: 340242 is the strongest match — the ethoxylate/Tween-SPAN block is the core of the catalogue and is correctly declared. 291540 matches MCA/SMCA. 290399 is a plausible but loose fit for Benzyl Chloride (a chlorinated aromatic; 2903.99 is the residual 'other' aryl halide line, so acceptable, though 2903.99 vs a more specific subheading should be confirmed against the actual customs line). WRONG/UNSUPPORTED: 293399 (other heterocyclic compounds) has no corroborating product anywhere on the site — the nearest item, Chlorhexidine Gluconate, is a biguanide salt and would not sit in 2933. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: the company stays in the base and the code is corrected to the actual product chemistry. MISSING FROM DECLARATION: DMAPA (292119), Dimethyl Sulphate (292090), Phenoxy Ethanol (290949), and the contract-manufactured specialty/toll formulations (3824 residual). INDUSTRY CLASSIFICATION: 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas + chemicals) is a misclassification — the catalogue is 100% specialty/surfactant chemistry with no oilfield, drilling-fluid, refinery or gas product line disclosed; correct industry is specialty chemicals / surfactants & surfactant intermediates. PRODUCT LINES MISSING FROM DECLARATION: the entire aroma chemicals vertical (page empty, no products named — cannot be coded), the API heading (no products named), and the antimicrobial/preservative pair. EVIDENCE STATUS: every product above is taken from the company's own website pages (mruchem.com/surfactants/, /aroma-chemicals/, /contract-manufacturing/) — these are catalogue claims only. No customs line, B-L or GST record was examined in this task, so all product-to-HS mappings are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The Aroma Chemicals and API verticals are additionally unverifiable even as claims, because the pages list no product names at all. Note: the site's 'Business statistics' counters render as 0+ in the fetched HTML (JS-driven), so no volume or customer figures could be read — null, not estimated.
